potential: 1 iff afterstate max rank >=13 and at least one maximum tile is in any corner; 0 otherwise; absorbing terminal potential 0
updates: late stage only; five-step TD(lambda=.5); alpha .02/.008/.003 at CPU fractions .6/.85; actual terminal
replay: 20% recent on-policy states, historical starts stratified by empty count and presence of 1536
initialization: Raw shaped-value tables initialized to V4 identically, so corrected initial V = V4 + coefficient*potential. This deliberately changes initialization bias; fully compensated initialization would largely cancel shaping.
inference: Use original rewards and raw shaped afterstate value + coefficient*potential. Never add per-step corner reward in search.
selection: Highest screening wins among control/weak/medium/strong; tie that order. Separately freeze best shaping arm, ties weak/medium/strong. No holdout inspection before freeze.
promotion: Screen winner vs V4 paired 95% lower bound >0; browser parity and timed compatibility pass. If fail preserve default V4 and expose V5 experimental.
limits: One training seed per arm; finite-budget result, not proof of general superiority
CPU stopping leads to slightly different episode counts; saved weights define results
Reward shaping preserves the original score objective in the exact episodic formulation, not a guaranteed increase in 6144 probability.
